message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through our closet, and guess what I stumbled upon? Our old go-bags! I had packed them ages ago but totally forgot they were there. It felt like a small win when I checked everything inside and realized we were actually ready for a quick getaway if needed. It’s comforting to know I have a little peace of mind tucked away. Have you discovered any hidden gems in your home that helped you feel more prepared? 🏡
